title: viguiera cordata var. websteri
intro: Viguiera cordata var. websteri, commonly known as a plant species within the family Asteraceae, is also referred to as a type of daisy or sunflower. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits associated with Viguiera cordata var. websteri include its ability to reduce inflammation and its potential to help manage conditions such as fever and pain. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
